chapters.title: Ordinary Least Squares
chapters.contentHtml:
Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) fits a linear function by minimizing the sum of squared residuals.

Core idea

Given feature matrix X and target vector y, we estimate parameters beta so predictions X * beta are as close as possible to y in L2 sense.

beta_hat = (X^T X)^(-1) X^T y

This closed-form solution works when X^T X is invertible. For high-dimensional or large-scale settings, gradient-based solvers are often preferred.

chapters.title: Kernel Functions
chapters.contentHtml:
Kernel functions enable models to learn non-linear boundaries without explicitly mapping data to higher dimensions.

Common kernels

  • Linear kernel: dot product in original space.
  • Polynomial kernel: captures interactions up to chosen degree.
  • RBF kernel: measures local similarity and produces flexible decision boundaries.

Model quality is heavily influenced by kernel choice and hyperparameters.
